messages:
maria: Hey — my PR #4128 just went red in CI after a rebase. mypy + eslint failing, not sure why. Anyone seen this pattern?
ci-bot: CI pipeline: https://ci.internal/reports/4128 — mypy: FAIL, eslint: FAIL, pre-commit: OK
kevin: hmm. last week we had a similar flap that traced to generated stubs changing types after a proto-gen bump.
jess: can you paste the top mypy error here?
maria: sure:
```
src/client/generated.py:47: error: Incompatible types in assignment (expression has type "float", variable has type "int")
Found 1 error in 1 file (checked 42 source files)
```
ryan: odd. generated client shouldn't have float->int like that. did you run make gen or commit the generated artifacts?
maria: I ran make gen locally and included the generated file in the commit. The diff shows Optional[timestamp] added for a few fields. eslint errors are mostly line-ending/prettier style in web/landing/*.tsx
kevin: might be a pre-commit hooks version mismatch on main vs your branch. Try restoring .pre-commit-config.yaml from origin/main and re-running pre-commit locally to see if it flips.
jess: also try a clean gen from the main proto container: `docker run --rm -v $PWD:/work proto-gen:latest make gen` — sometimes local tools differ.
maria: I tried renaming the generated file to force regen, still same type annotation noise. I'll push a tiny change to trigger CI rerun if that helps.
ryan: if you want a faster check, push a noop commit like `touch .ci-rerun` and we can queue a rerun.
maria: pushed noop commit (2033054322) — rerun queued.
ci-bot: Rerun started for PR #4128 (build 2033054323)
ci-bot: Rerun finished: mypy: PASS, eslint: FAIL (web/landing/hero.tsx: max-len + linebreaks)
ryan: eslint max-len often from unwrapped long markdown links. Could be a docs copy change in the same PR.
maria: found a long URL in landing content, wrapped it and added a .editorconfig EOL fix, pushed (2033054325).
ci-bot: New run complete: all checks green :white_check_mark:
maria: PR is green now, thanks team :party:
kevin: thanks — if this repeats we should pin the pre-commit hooks and add a small CI job to validate generated stubs match a canonical generator image.
jess: agree. filing a quick infra ticket to pin hashes and add a regeneration smoke test.
ryan: noted, thanks for the quick triage @maria.
